messages.まずはストーリーを進め、遊びながらできることを増やそう。: Start with the story and unlock more activities as you play.
messages.最初はメインストーリーを進めるのがおすすめ。新しいコンテンツや育成先が順に開くの: Start by progressing through the main story. New activities and upgrade options unlock along the way, so there is no need to take too many detours until battles become difficult.
messages.囚人はキャラクター、人格は戦闘で選ぶバージョン、E.G.Oは戦闘中に資源を使って: A Sinner is a character; an Identity is a version of that character selected for battle. E.G.O are powerful skills activated by spending resources during combat. Each Identity has different skills and strengths. Select a Sinner from the list to browse their Identities.
messages.手持ちから出撃メンバーを選ぼう: Choose your deployed team from what you own
messages.まずは使える人格を中心に編成し、それぞれのスキルと耐性を見てみよう。最初から状態: Build around the Identities available to you, and look at their skills and resistances. You do not need to commit to a single status effect or affiliation from the start. Each Identity page explains its role and how to use it.
messages.全員を一度に育てず、よく使う人格から整える。: Focus on the Identities you use most rather than upgrading everyone at once.
messages.まずは出撃する人格を育てる: Upgrade the Identities you plan to deploy first
messages.使う予定の人格を優先し、レベルと同期化を強化しよう。レベルは基礎能力、同期化はス: Prioritize levels and Uptie for the Identities you intend to use. Levels improve basic stats, while Uptie unlocks and strengthens skills and passives. Check the required materials and upgrade effects before spending resources.
messages.詰まった場所に合わせて強化する: Upgrade according to what is holding you back
messages.敵とのレベル差が大きいならレベル、スキルやパッシブが未解放なら同期化を見直そう。: If enemies greatly outlevel you, review your levels. If skills or passives are still locked, review Uptie. Use enemy information on the deployment screen and your team's current upgrades as a guide, rather than a fixed level based only on story progress.
messages.素材は足りないものから集める: Farm the materials you are missing
messages.人格学習チケットが足りなければ経験値採光、同期化素材が足りなければ紐採光を候補に: Consider EXP Luxcavation when you need Identity Training Tickets, or Thread Luxcavation when you need Uptie materials. Check unlocks and rewards in the game, and keep some Enkephalin for story progression.
messages.E.G.Oの強化は必要になってから: Upgrade E.G.O when you need to
messages.E.G.Oは解析で強化できる。素材を一度に使い切らず、よく使うE.G.Oや効果を: Threadspin upgrades E.G.O. Avoid spending all your materials at once; first check which E.G.O you use often and what each upgrade provides.
messages.毎日は採光、週ごとは鏡ダンジョンを目安に、育成素材と交換用の報酬を集めよう。: Use daily Luxcavations and weekly Mirror Dungeon runs to gather upgrade materials and rewards for the Dispenser.
messages.毎日の採光で育成素材を補充する: Replenish upgrade materials through daily Luxcavations
messages.経験値採光では人格のレベル上げに使う人格学習チケット、紐採光では人格の同期化やE: EXP Luxcavation provides Identity Training Tickets for levels. Thread Luxcavation provides Thread for Uptie and E.G.O Threadspin. Choose EXP when you need levels, or Thread when you need Uptie. If daily bonus rewards remain, use them on the materials you need before the daily reset.
messages.エンケファリンを採光に使うか、モジュールに変える: Spend Enkephalin on Luxcavations or convert it into Modules
messages.エンケファリンはストーリーや採光に使い、モジュールは鏡ダンジョンや採光のスキップ: Enkephalin is used for the story and Luxcavations, while Modules are used for activities such as Mirror Dungeons and skipping Luxcavations. Keep Enkephalin when you plan to progress the story. Convert what you will not use soon, or what would otherwise exceed the cap, into Modules. Skipping Luxcavations saves time but gives fewer rewards per Module than fighting normally.
messages.毎週の鏡ダンジョンでパス報酬を進める: Advance the Battle Pass with weekly Mirror Dungeon runs
messages.鏡ダンジョンのクリア報酬ではバトルパス経験値を得られ、週のボーナスを使うと追加報: Mirror Dungeon completion rewards include Battle Pass EXP, with additional rewards when you use weekly bonuses. Bonuses reset each week, so check how many remain on the reward screen. Start with a difficulty you can clear reliably; try Hard once you have unlocked it.
messages.集めた報酬を育成と交換に回す: Put your rewards toward upgrades and the Dispenser
messages.採光はすぐ使う育成素材、鏡ダンジョンはバトルパスや自我の破片ボックスを集めるのに: Luxcavations are useful for upgrade materials you need immediately. Mirror Dungeons help you advance the Battle Pass and obtain Egoshard Crates. Farm Luxcavations for an Identity you want to upgrade, or collect shards through Mirror Dungeon rewards when you have an Identity or E.G.O in mind for the Dispenser.
messages.戦闘に詰まったとき: When you get stuck in battle
messages.負けた原因を一つずつ見て、育成か操作かを切り分けよう。: Review the causes of defeat one at a time to work out whether you need upgrades or a different approach.
messages.敵と味方のレベル・耐性を見比べる: Compare enemy and ally levels and resistances
messages.敵のレベルが高い、攻撃タイプへの耐性が合わないなど、出撃前の情報に手がかりがある: Pre-battle information can reveal problems such as an enemy level advantage or poor resistance matchups. Replacing an Identity that is weak to the enemy's attack type may be enough to make the battle easier.
messages.味方のスキルを敵の攻撃に割り当てると、攻撃同士のマッチが起きる。敵の強い攻撃を止: Assigning an ally's skill against an enemy attack can create a Clash. To stop a dangerous attack, check your chances of winning before committing a skill. The forecast does not always determine the final outcome.
messages.精神力は通常コインの表が出る確率に関わる。スキルの基本威力・コイン威力や効果文も: SP affects the chance of rolling Heads on normal Coins. Read Base Power, Coin Power, and skill effects, and check whether you have met the conditions that let each Identity perform well.
messages.ボスの説明を読んで、編成を見直す: Read the boss's mechanics and adjust your team
messages.ボスのパッシブや部位の説明に、対処方法が書かれていることがある。苦手な状態異常や: A boss's passive and part descriptions may explain how to deal with it. Once you identify useful status effects or attack types, adjust your Identities, resistances, and support. The boss guides cover difficult encounters in Chapters 3–7; start with the battle you are stuck on.
messages.鏡ダンジョン・人格の交換について: Mirror Dungeons and obtaining Identities from the Dispenser
messages.鏡ダンジョンの報酬を、バトルパスと自我の破片につなげる。: Turn Mirror Dungeon rewards into Battle Pass progress and Egoshards.
messages.鏡ダンジョンはバトルパスを進める場所: Mirror Dungeons advance the Battle Pass
messages.鏡ダンジョンをクリアするとバトルパス経験値を獲得できる。パス報酬には育成素材や自: Clearing a Mirror Dungeon grants Battle Pass EXP. Pass rewards include upgrade materials and Egoshard Crates. If you are stuck in the story, upgrade the Identities you need before trying a run.
messages.高難易度を急ぐ必要はない。今の編成で安定して進める難易度を選び、報酬受け取り時に: There is no need to rush into a higher difficulty. Choose one your current team can handle reliably, and check bonus uses, extra rewards, and Module costs when claiming rewards. Hard has unlock requirements; follow the in-game information.
messages.通常の「自我の破片ボックス」はランダムな囚人の破片、「自我の破片セレクトボックス: An Egoshard Crate gives shards for a random Sinner. A Nominable Egoshard Crate lets you choose the Sinner when opening it. Either type gives 1–3 shards per Crate. If you know which Identity or E.G.O you want, prioritize Nominable Crates so you can choose the corresponding Sinner.
messages.ボックスから集めた囚人ごとの自我の破片は、自販機でその囚人の人格やE.G.Oと交: Each Sinner's Egoshards can be exchanged for that Sinner's Identities or E.G.O at the Dispenser. Requirements and available seasons differ by item, so check the item you want before opening Nominable Crates for the corresponding Sinner.
messages.人格・E.G.Oによって交換できる時期や条件が異なる。自販機に並んでいるかを確認: Dispenser availability and conditions vary by Identity and E.G.O. Check whether the item is available before deciding which Sinner's shards to collect. Requirements and availability may change, so use the latest in-game information.
messages.抽出と交換を使い分ける: Choose between Extraction and the Dispenser
messages.欲しいものが自販機にあるなら、抽出を続ける前に必要な破片と手持ちを比べよう。交換: If the item you want is available in the Dispenser, compare its shard cost with what you own before continuing to Extract. The Dispenser lets you choose an item, but collecting shards takes time. Check current Extraction offerings and limited-time availability before deciding.
messages.迷ったらゲーム内の最新表示を見て、使い道を決めてから消費する。: When unsure, check the latest in-game information and decide how you will use a resource before spending it.
messages.狂気は抽出やエンケファリン回復などに使える。使い道を決める前に、今開催中の抽出内: Lunacy can be used for Extraction, Enkephalin refills, and other purposes. Check the current Extraction offerings and consider how often you play before deciding how to spend it.
messages.シーズンが変わると、交換対象やパス報酬などが切り替わる。破片やボックスを使う前に: A new season changes Dispenser availability, Pass rewards, and other content. Check the Dispenser and in-game notices before spending shards or opening Crates.
messages.用語が分からないとき: When you do not understand a term
messages.戦闘中に見慣れない言葉が出たら、用語辞典で共通の仕組みを確認しよう。人格固有の効: Look up unfamiliar combat terms in the glossary. For effects unique to an Identity, also read the effect descriptions on that Identity's detail page.
messages.まずはストーリーを進めよう。戦闘に詰まったら育成を見直し、毎日の採光と毎週の鏡ダ: Start with the story. When battles become difficult, review your upgrades and strengthen your team through daily Luxcavations and weekly Mirror Dungeon runs.
messages.ゲーム開始前の抽出で迷ったら、リセマラガイドへ →: Unsure about your starting pulls? Read the reroll guide →
messages.おすすめ人格と終了ライン、端末ごとの注意点を確認。: Recommended Identities, when to stop, and platform-specific considerations.
messages.敵の狙い・速度を見て、1ターンのマッチを割り当てる例を追う。: Follow a sample turn, using enemy targets and Speed to assign Clashes.
messages.ゲーム内で確認できる報酬・解放条件を優先する。抽出内容やシーズン報酬など更新され: Follow the rewards and unlock requirements shown in the game. Recheck changing information, such as Extraction offerings and seasonal rewards, when you play.
messages.鏡ダンジョンから人格交換まで: From Mirror Dungeon rewards to the Dispenser
messages.通常報酬や上限後の超過報酬にボックス: Obtain Crates from regular and post-cap rewards
messages.集めた破片で人格・E.G.Oを選ぶ: Choose Identities or E.G.O using your shards
messages.誰の破片が出るかランダム。特定の交換先が決まっていないとき向け。: The Sinner is random. Useful when you do not have a specific Dispenser item in mind.
messages.開封時に囚人を選べる。交換したい人格・E.G.Oに合わせて使える。: Choose a Sinner when opening it, according to the Identity or E.G.O you want.
messages.鏡ダンジョン1回分のバトルパス進行目安: Battle Pass progress from one Mirror Dungeon clear
messages.上限後のセレクトボックス: Nominable Crates after the Pass cap
messages.最終層までクリアした場合の報酬。ハードの数値は、その週のボーナスをまだ使っていな: Rewards assume completion of the final floor. Hard values assume that none of that week's bonuses have been used before claiming rewards. Each level requires 10 EXP; the table starts at 0 progress. Leftover progress carries over. Crate counts apply after all regular Pass rewards have been claimed: each additional level gives 1 Crate on the free Pass, or 3 in total with the purchased Limbus Pass.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)を始めたばかりの人向けのガイド。ストーリ: A beginner's guide to Limbus Company: story progression, upgrades, daily routines, and Dispenser priorities, explained step by step.
